decisions.reason: It extends the firm’s core handcrafted seasonal décor with limited additional uncertainty, and two years of prominent placement suggest enough demand to keep the option open.
As a close variant of the firm’s core Christmas pyramid range, it fits existing capabilities well and appears to have revealed solid enough market acceptance to remain in the assortment.
The electronic music box is more distant from the traditional craft base, but its repeated prominence and the later addition of complementary motif products indicate the line still has option value.
A second edition in 2019 is a positive signal that the firm saw continuing demand, so despite being outside the traditional core it is still worth retaining.

This seasonal motif platform is a narrower complement in a more uncertain electronic line, and by 2022 the firm would likely prune such a specific variant if it had not clearly become a durable seller.
This product builds directly on the established Christmas pyramid business and likely uses existing designs and production routines, making it inexpensive to keep relative to its potential value.
